notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on cost ($115,000 LF vs $75,000 + $38,000 optic RPCQ), lens maker (Sautter vs Barbier, Bénard et Turenne), facing (marble/brick/stone) and dwelling demolition (1956 vs 1981); the story states these. Keeper roster comes only from Lighthouse Friends (copyrighted, facts only); the Marine reports confirm only Costin in 1901/1904. Staff-list names matched by column position in OCR. 1900-report keeper unnamed in the passage. Fiscal-year labels follow corpus convention (year the fiscal year ends). Radio-Canada article year not confirmed in text (undated in fetched copy); only DFO responsibility and five-person limit are used. No Canadian pre-1900 reports in corpus, so 1858-1899 events rest on heritage statements and Lighthouse Friends. The 1942 U-boat sighting is Lighthouse Friends only. Opening hours for 2026 shown on the site; check before visiting. Not read: Parks Canada DFHD page (empty on fetch), CCG List of Lights (current characteristic/range come from our record only). Verifier: height stated as about 34 m (RPCQ, Radio-Canada) because no source read gives 34.1 m (that figure is from the record/Wikidata). Opening line 1 and Today now cite sources that say each part. Keeper list entry 'Yvon Élément' follows Lighthouse Friends' garbled print. Radio-Canada's five-person limit report is undated in the copy read. RPCQ dates construction 1854-58 vs HSMBC 1853-58 (now stated). Fog-signal and dwelling-repair paragraph moved from After the keepers to The keepers (all happened while keepers served).
